tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Urban Infrastructure Development and Finance Corporation Limited

generalCriterionList.description: Single entity or Joint venture(maximum 2 members) is Acceptable

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should quote exclusive of GST
Tenderer are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
Should comply all the conditions of the tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2(b) Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as UGD project / STP project/ water supply project/ Irrigation Projects /combined water supply & sewerage project/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Road/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Layout works/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Buildings value not less than Rs. 6.53 Crores. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement

3.2(c) Executed in any one year of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) the following minimum quantities of works. (1) Earthwork excavation in all kinds of soil by mechanical / manual means - 5561 Cum (2) Cement concrete (Including RCC & PCC) -2394 Cum (3) TMT Steel - 149.5 Ton. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement in the same financial year. Note: The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public Sector Undertaking

3.2(d) The tenderer or his identified subcontractor should possess experience in Construction of 1 Nos of SBR/ NEBR/ equivalent/any other type STP/ WTP/ETP works with a minimum of 5.0 MLD Capacity. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement. Note: (1) The Experience certificate from the competent Govt /Semi Govt. /Public sector undertaking shall be furnished. The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public Sector Undertaking. (2) Turnover and the value of completed work shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited. (3) Value of the work mentioned in the work done certificate shall be Excluding GST (4) If the bidder has submitted work done certificate in JV, only JV share will be considered for evaluation purpose. (5) The sub-contractor should provide his consent for associating with the bidder for this tender package. (6) The subcontractor should also provide his experience certificate/ documents for the claimed works

3.3 (a) availability by owning at least 50% of the required/specified key and critical equipment for this work and (b) the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease /hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.) for availability for this work are furnished. (1) Excavators - Total-2 Nos. (Owned -1 No. and Hired -1 No) (2) Tippers- Total-4 Nos. (Owned -2 No. and Hired -2 No) (3) Self-loading Concrete mixer - Total-2 Nos. (Owned -1 No. and Hired -1 No) If the bid is submitted as joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement. Note: The bidder shall provide invoice / RC book copies for owned vehicles and for lease / hire vehicles, agreement along with RC book/ invoice copy for vehicles

3.2(a) Achieved in each of the at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 26.10 Crores (i)Audited profit and loss account statement/ balance sheets certified by the chartered accountant, (ii) Turnover certificate with UDIN and (iii) IT returns filed for the above indicated 5 years is to be uploaded along with the technical bid. If the bid is submitted as JV, then the requirement of minimum financial turnover shall be considered on the basis of combined resources. The lead partner should have an annual financial turnover of not less than 51% of total turnover indicated above in any two financial years during last 5 financial years. All document/certificates issued by a Charted Accountant should have a UDIN (unique document Identification Number) generated through the ICAI (The Institute of chartered Accountants of India) Portal. Certificate without UDIN the documents uploaded will be considered and treated as invalid documents. Note: In case of JV, Joint venture partnership deed shall be submitted as per section 10 format for Joint Venture along with the other documents through KPP Portal. (1) Individual - Rs. 26.10 Cr. (2) Joint Venture- Lead Member - Not less than Rs. 13.31 Cr.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.3(b) Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 3.92 Crores (credit lines/letter of credit/Certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in the peak construction period) in the form of unconditional credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificate from any Nationalized Banks/ Scheduled Banks from Karnataka - India as per the prescribed format. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement. Note: Liquid assets in the form of credit line/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., shall be in the format appended with the bid document. Any conditional Banker Certificate will not be accepted and will lead to disqualification

3.6 Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity means (AxNx1.50 - B) Where A means Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N means Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited B means Value, at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year. Note: (1) The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated completion period, remaining period for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. (2) In case of JV, values of A and B shall be the sum total of the respective figures of all the Partners

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of Sewage Treatment Plant of 10 MLD in Madanayakanahalli town along with 5 years Operation & Maintenance (including 1-year Defect liability period) under SBM (U)-2.0 fund through Design, Built, Operate and Transfer (DBOT) model

itemList.description: PART- A: 1) Construction of 10.00 MLD capacity SBR type STP or any other Equivalent technology STP at Madanayakanahalli Town. a) Construction of Inlet Chamber, Mechanical and Manual Fine Screen, Grit chamber and Inlet Channel b) Construction of 2 Nos of SBR Basins Tanks and Anoxic Zone. c) Construction of Chlorine Contact Tank, Sludge Sump Tank, Distribution Channel, Air Blower, PLC cum MCC Panel Room, Chlorination Room, Admin Room, Sludge Pump House, Guard Room with Toilet and 5 Nos of Sludge Drying Beds. d) Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Electromechanical items for SBR technology STP, including necessary piping, valves, and electrical works, etc. e) Supply, Installation, and Commissioning of 11kV express feeder line for STP. f) Laying of Outfall Sewer Pipeline from Treatment Plant to Natural nala. g) Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning of OCEMS along with Transmission of Quality Parameters Index of KSPCB and CPCB Portal for STP. h) Construction of Internal roads, Precast Compound Wall and Landscaping works at STP. i) Providing and installation of Borewell complete. j) Any other appurtenance/Allied works applicable as per the site conditions and design requirement k) Other allied works to complete the work. Note: 1) Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the engineer in charge. 2) All works and items shall be executed to be carried out as per IS code, CPHEEO manual, KSPCB, Prevailing NGT and Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban 2.0 guidelines and specifications mentioned in the contract. 3) Drawings are enclosed only for tender purpose 4) The effluent should meet required NGT standards.

Part B - O & M for 1st Year Madanayakanahalli Town - Operation and Maintenance of the proposed STP which includes, providing technical staff, operators, and others who are required to run the system as per Govt orders in a complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required, for the operation of STP works.
Note: Helpers / Watchman / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at STP. The contractor should maintain a Logbook on the working of pumping machinery at the STP. The effluent should meet required NGT standards and contractor should submit report.

Part B - O & M for 2nd Year Madanayakanahalli Town - Operation and Maintenance of the proposed STP which includes, providing technical staff, operators, and others who are required to run the system as per Govt orders in a complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required, for the operation of STP works 1. Regular maintenance of all civil structures inside the STP premises. The maintenance consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, and painting for civil structures   2.
